bibliography: Uesugi, Heindio (ed.) & Adam Alvah Catt (editorial supervisor). 2024. Old Avestan Dictionary. (Asian and African Lexicon 67.) Tokyo: Research Institute for Languages and Cultures of Asia and Africa (ILCAA), Tokyo University of Foreign Studies. ISBN 978-4-86337-542-0.

page_ranges.assertions: 404 dictionary pages; every running head except printed p. 1 carries printed page = PDF page - 29

scope.included: Part I Dictionary, printed pp. 1-404: every ◊ and ♣ lemma
excluded: Part II Text and Translation (PDF pp. 434-558): Yasna 27.13-15, Gāθās Y28-53, 54.1 with interlinear glosses
front matter (acknowledgements, preface, abbreviations, introduction, references)
inflected attestations, passage citations and translations (audit only)
F cross-references from inflected forms to lemmata (audit only)
Vedic, Sanskrit, Young Avestan and other comparanda inside entries (prose only)

extraction.method: pdfplumber character layer: two columns split at the page midpoint, lines clustered by top (±5 pt), combining marks re-attached to their stream/geometric base, NFC; font classes mark headwords (bold), F-line forms (bold italic), and the Wingdings/Verdana structural markers

language_model: all rows Language_ID Av; Old Avestan lemmata carry the proposed dialect tag dialect:Av:OAv:Old%20Avestan; lemmata printed in square brackets (non-Old-Avestan material, e.g. Y27.15, Y42) carry no dialect tag

classes: unquoted primary definition before the quoted gloss (haoma-): 8 entries fixed in editorial.csv
printed unclosed parenthesis hid a noun sense (arədra-): editorial fix; all 7 unbalanced headers flagged in the audit
non-material: spaced label '(rel. adv.)' not tagged; parser fixed
quotes glossing a word cited in unparenthesised prose were taken as senses (maidiiōi.mā̊ŋha-): parser now stops at prose citing a bold word
